title: French spoken at home and his grandmother's French books
summary: He speaks some French, his family spoke only French and attended an all-French school, and he shows his grandmother's old French books.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Do you speak any other language besides French?

No, only what I want to speak when I go in them different countries and when I want something or get some guy to tell me what I'd like, to go to a restaurant or a taxi, take him in a taxi till I get the layout of how much money I should give him, you know, whatever -- pesos or whatever. And things like that. But I can speak a lot of French. All my people were French. They couldn't speak English at all.
So French was spoken in your home?
See, they couldn't speak English at all.
They went to an all-French school. I got some French books right there I'll show you a little later on from my grandmother. You can pull those three down there. See down there? Yeah.
-- and they're all written in French.
